name: CONTENT-RUNTIME-AUTH
status: Implemented in knode-content (G1-G9); verified with unit/H2 tests and real Gateway+User+Content JAR + native MySQL 8.0.43 + TLS/ACL RESP substitute integration; live Nacos/OTLP/VM Redis/OSS/peer domains pending.

runtime.management: separate loopback port; expose health and prometheus
runtime.readiness: database connection, authoritative session Redis GET, optional Nacos discovery and optional Sentinel governance rules must succeed
runtime.schema: automatic SQL, Flyway and Liquibase disabled by default
runtime.redis: TLS required, configure trusted CA with JVM truststore; standalone host and port; username restricted to GET on session key namespace
runtime.readTimeout: 800ms reactive timeout, 1000ms blocking upper bound; no positive cache
runtime.publicKey: supports KNODE_AUTH_PUBLIC_KEY_ID/KNODE_AUTH_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE plus overlapping multi-kid KNODE_AUTH_TRUSTED_PUBLIC_KEYS (up to 4 distinct kids, >= 2048-bit RSA) for zero-downtime key rotation
runtime.startup: required auth and DB settings, public key and TLS must be valid or startup fails

auth.routes: Exact public GET and counter PUT routes are anonymous. Only exact internal outbox summary/redelivery routes use machine Bearer verification; other routes retain user auth. Spoofed identity headers are rejected.
auth.errors: HTTP 401/business 401 invalid token/session; HTTP 403/business 403 scope; HTTP 503/business 500 unavailable or malformed session state
auth.authorization: Admin article/category/tag/link/upload routes revalidate current permission and subject through User /api/admin/auth/me on every request; *:*:* only if explicitly returned. Blog author methods retain ownership checks.

build.rootIntegration: controller to request infra add <module>knode-content</module> to root pom.xml

notImplemented: real VM Redis and real Aliyun OSS live verification
verification: Unit/SpringBootTest suite (H2 + mocked/synthetic providers + Sentinel FlowRule + OTel InMemorySpanExporter) plus real Gateway+User+Content production JAR E2E against isolated native MySQL 8.0.43 and isolated TLS 1.3 ACL-enforced RESP protocol substitute (reports/microservices/g9-content-cross-service/verification.json). Live Nacos, OTLP collector, VM Redis, real OSS, and real peer business domains are not claimed as verified.
articleSlice: Blog POST and authorized admin article create/edit/status/delete implemented; internal author methods enforce ownership. Local immutable facts only.
